Town Cats / 小镇猫咪

[size=4][color=#00ffff][font=Times New Roman][i][b]如果大家有任何建议或者期待的功能，随时欢迎提出！  Suggestions and feedback are always welcome. [/b][/i][/font][/color][/size]

[heading]Town Cats 3.1.0[/heading]
中文
[list]
[*]新增[color=#9900ff]野猫熟悉度系统[/color]。每只猫需要投喂 3–8 条鱼，每位玩家分别记录进度。[/*]
[*]熟悉度未满时，每天只能投喂同一只猫一次；熟悉后可以继续投喂。[/*]
[*]靠近猫两格内会显示投喂进度，计数位于猫头顶上方。[/*]
[*]成功投喂后，猫会显示爱心并发出一声原版猫叫。[/*]
[*]现在[color=#9900ff]可以抚摸正常游荡的猫[/color]。[color=#9900ff]刚认识的猫容易炸毛后跳，持续投喂会让它逐渐接受抚摸[/color]。[/*]
[*]与猫足够熟悉后，继续投喂可能[color=#9900ff]触发神秘礼物事件[/color]。[/*]
[*]所有玩家会收到阿比盖尔寄来的新信件。[/*]
[*]打架云团造成伤害时，现在会显示扣血数字。[/*]
[*]第一阶段和第三阶段仍可右键劝架；第二阶段的打架云团无法直接互动。[/*]
[*]新增内容均提供简体中文和英文。[/*]
[*]联机时，每位玩家的投喂进度和每日记录相互独立。[/*]
[/list]English
[list]
[*]Added a [color=#9900ff]familiarity system for the stray cats[/color]. Each cat requires 3–8 fish, with progress tracked separately for every player.[/*]
[*]Before a cat becomes familiar with you, it can only be fed once per day. Familiar cats can continue to be fed.[/*]
[*]Feeding progress appears just above a cat when you come within two tiles.[/*]
[*]After a successful feeding, the cat shows a heart and responds with the vanilla cat meow.[/*]
[*]Normal [color=#9900ff]stray cats can now be petted[/color]. [color=#9900ff]Cats that barely know you may bristle and hop away, while continued feeding gradually helps them accept your touch.[/color][/*]
[*]Once a cat knows you well enough, continuing to feed it may trigger a [color=#9900ff]mysterious gift event[/color].[/*]
[*]Every player receives a new letter from Abigail.[/*]
[*]Fight-cloud damage now displays the amount of health lost.[/*]
[*]Right-click peacekeeping remains available during stages one and three. The stage-two fight cloud cannot be interacted with directly.[/*]
[*]All new content is available in Simplified Chinese and English.[/*]
[*]In multiplayer, feeding progress and daily records are tracked separately for each player.[/*]
[/list]

[heading]中文（ English description below.）[/heading]
功能介绍
[color=#9900ff]Town Cats 会在鹈鹕镇中加入会自由活动的猫咪。[/color]
[color=#9900ff]猫咪平时会在小镇中游荡、休息，当两只猫距离过近时，可能会开始争吵。争斗会经历[b]哈气、扑击、打架、恢复对峙[/b]等阶段，并且有一定概率继续下一轮。[/color]
玩家可以使用[color=#9900ff][b]有水的水壶[/b]浇正在哈气或恢复中的猫，将它们驱散[/color]。猫也会受到墙体、建筑、玩家、NPC 和其他障碍物影响，不会隔着障碍直接触发争斗。
玩家可以右键两只打架的猫[color=#9900ff]进行劝架[/color]，[color=#9900ff]会触发对话有概率劝架成功[/color]。

[code]Town[/code]地图随机生成猫咪[/*]

[*][color=#9900ff]可以使用水壶驱散部分争斗状态[/color][/*]
[*][color=#9900ff]带有距离和左右声像变化的哈气声音[/color][/*]
[*][color=#9900ff]支持多人联机同步[/color][/*]
[*][color=#9900ff]午夜后猫咪会停止争斗并寻找位置休息[/color][/*]
[*][color=#9900ff]允许使用鱼投喂小猫[/color][/*]
[/list][b]适用版本：Stardew Valley 1.6、SMAPI 4.0 或更高版本。[/b]

如果 F8 与其他 Mod 冲突，可以在 SMAPI 控制台输入：

English
[heading]Features[/heading]
Town Cats adds roaming cats to Pelican Town.
[color=#9900ff]Cats will normally wander around and rest. When two cats get too close, they may start a dispute and go through several stages, including [b]hissing, lunging, fighting, and recovery[/b].[/color]
[color=#9900ff]Players can use a [b]watering can with water[/b] to break up cats during certain stages. Walls, buildings, players, NPCs, and other obstacles can also block cats from detecting each other.[/color]
Main features:
[list]
[*]Random roaming cats on the
[code]Town[/code]map[/*]
[*][color=#9900ff]8 cats by default, configurable from 0 to 40[/color][/*]
[*][color=#9900ff]Cats can wander, sleep, fight, and run away[/color][/*]
[*][color=#9900ff]Nearby cats may automatically start disputes[/color][/*]
[*][color=#9900ff]Hissing, lunge, fight-cloud, and recovery stages[/color][/*]
[*][color=#9900ff]Watering can interaction to break up certain fights[/color][/*]
[*][color=#9900ff]Positional hissing audio with distance and stereo panning[/color][/*]
[*][color=#9900ff]Multiplayer synchronization[/color][/*]
[*][color=#9900ff]Cats stop fighting and look for a place to sleep at midnight[/color][/*]
[*][color=#9900ff]Allows you to feed kittens fish. [/color][/*]
[/list][b]Requires Stardew Valley 1.6 and SMAPI 4.0 or later.[/b]
For multiplayer, [b]the host and every connected player must install the same version of the mod[/b].
[heading]Installation[/heading]
[list=1]
[*]Install [b]SMAPI 4.0 or later[/b].[/*]
[*]Extract
[code]TownCats-0.1.0-beta.zip[/code].[/*]
[*]Move the entire
[code]TownCats[/code]folder into:[/*]
[/list][code]Stardew Valley/Mods/[/code]The final folder structure should look like:
[code]Stardew Valley/
└─ Mods/
   └─ TownCats/
      ├─ manifest.json
      ├─ TownCats.dll
      └─ ...[/code]Do not place it inside an extra nested folder such as:
[code]Mods/TownCats/TownCats/[/code][list=1]
[*]Launch the game through SMAPI.[/*]
[/list]Press [b]F8[/b] after loading a save to change the number of cats.
If F8 conflicts with another mod, use the SMAPI console command:
[code]towncats_config[/code]To check the current cat status:
[code]towncats_status[/code]This is currently a [b]Beta[/b] release. For multiplayer issues, keep the SMAPI logs from both the host and affected clients.
